payload.description_html: Various dinosaurs and pterosaurs from the Hell Creek Formation. From back to front: Ankylosaurus, Tyrannosaurus, Quetzalcoatlus, Triceratops, Struthiomimus, Pachycephalosaurus, Acheroraptor and Anzu respectively.
